name: Einkorn Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies (Half Batch)
ingredients:
6 tbsp butter
1/2 cup brown sugar (light or dark; organic is fine)
2 tbsp white sugar
1 large egg, with about 1 tbsp of the white tipped out
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup Bluebird einkorn flour
Heaping 1/4 tsp baking soda (3/8 tsp)
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup chocolate chips
Flaky salt, for topping
directions:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Let it boil, then foam, then keep stirring until it turns light brown and smells nutty. Cool about 10 minutes, until warm but not hot.
2. In a large bowl, mix the browned butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until combined. If the sugar has coarse crystals, mix a little longer.
3. Crack the egg and tip out about 1 tbsp of the white. Add the egg and vanilla to the bowl and mix until just combined.
4. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix until just combined; do not overmix.
5. Fold in the chocolate chips.
6. Scoop into 2-inch balls and place on a baking sheet. Refrigerate 45-60 minutes, or freeze 20-25 minutes.
7. Preheat the oven to 350°F while the dough chills. Top each ball with a pinch of flaky salt.
8. Bake 9-11 minutes, until the edges are set and the centers still look slightly underdone.
9. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes, then move to a wire rack.
description: Half batch of Bluebird Grain Farms' einkorn chocolate chip cookie with browned butter and a short chill, ready in about 1.5 hours.
notes:
Using the whole egg without tipping out any white makes the dough wetter; if you do, chill overnight to control spread.

With more time, chilling overnight (up to 24 hr) gives less spread and deeper flavor.

Frozen einkorn flour can go straight into the dough without thawing.

Full batch: double everything except the egg, which becomes 1 whole egg plus 1 yolk.
